shared_mechanism: Short projects create verified skills and useful outputs
assumption_to_test: SMEs can scope and assess work
vietnam_adaptation: Managed sustainability tasks with mentor acceptance and portfolios
baseline: Freelancer or student agency or internship
failure_condition: No repeat paid buyers or mentor cost destroys margin

shared_mechanism: Reusable assets create value through return circulation
assumption_to_test: Returns are convenient and cleaning economical
vietnam_adaptation: Closed commuter cluster with meal boxes and controlled washing
baseline: Disposable packaging and existing reusable services
failure_condition: Return and washing cost exceed buyer value

shared_mechanism: Time-sensitive surplus is matched to nearby demand
assumption_to_test: Buyers accept uncertainty and safety information is available
vietnam_adaptation: Specific food category on routine routes with traceable lots
failure_condition: Low fee cannot fund handling or no actual surplus

assumption_to_test: A family needs coordination beyond existing chat
vietnam_adaptation: Multiple children share tasks and payments with consent
failure_condition: No improvement over checklist or no paid renewal

shared_mechanism: Spoken narrative becomes a durable family artifact
assumption_to_test: A single narrator is the useful unit
vietnam_adaptation: Multi-narrator attributed memories with family approval
baseline: Audio recording and photo album and memoir service
failure_condition: Editing labor prevents viable margin or no deposits

shared_mechanism: Small groups reduce friction of meeting others
vietnam_adaptation: Stable four-week local groups with shared activities
failure_condition: No attendance retention or no willingness to pay

vietnam_adaptation: Voluntary trusted-family second look before payment
baseline: Checklist and nTrust for comparable checks
failure_condition: Users ignore warnings or false alarms destroy trust

shared_mechanism: Passive materials reduce heat burden of buildings
assumption_to_test: Material surface results transfer to indoor comfort and payer value
vietnam_adaptation: Cluster assessment and retrofit purchased by property operator
failure_condition: No incremental indoor benefit or buyer does not pay
